newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares tumble in nervous late IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares tumble in nervous late IBIS trade.

text.p: 1303 GMT - German shares fall nearly one and half percentage points in afternoon electronic trade, as an unwelcome downturn in U.S. Treasuries hits trade described by traders as "nervous and paranoid" before Wall Street opening. Dealers say little evidence of a major sell-off but say sentiment to remain jittery in advance of Dow Jones opening bell in very technical market.
* 30-share IBIS DAX index down 46.76 points, or 1.42 percent, at 3,234.70 points, off a low of 3,214.48 points, conclusively penetrating technical support at 3,300 points.
* June DAX DTB future at 3,240 points, down 54.
